mapper.select: select id, event_type, rule_name, point_value, daily_limit, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from wl_point_rule where event_type = #{eventType} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
select id, event_type, rule_name, point_value, daily_limit, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from wl_point_rule where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update wl_wx_user set point_balance = point_balance - #{amount}, update_time = now() where id = #{userId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0' and point_balance >= #{amount}
update wl_wx_user set point_balance = point_balance + #{amount}, update_time = now() where id = #{userId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select point_balance from wl_wx_user where id = #{userId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from wl_ad_reward_record where user_id = #{userId} and reward_date = #{rewardDate} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into wl_ad_reward_record(user_id, ad_biz_no, reward_date, awarded_points, point_record_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values(#{userId}, #{adBizNo}, #{rewardDate}, #{awardedPoints}, #{pointRecordId}, 'system', now(), '', now(), '0')

insert into wl_signin_record(user_id, signin_date, awarded_points, point_record_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values(#{userId}, #{signinDate}, #{awardedPoints}, #{pointRecordId}, 'system', now(), '', now(), '0')

insert into wl_share_task_record(user_id, share_date, share_scene, awarded_points, point_record_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values(#{userId}, #{shareDate}, 'INVITE', #{awardedPoints}, #{pointRecordId}, 'system', now(), '', now(), '0')

insert ignore into wl_invitation(inviter_user_id, invited_user_id, invite_code, reward_status, invited_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values(#{inviterUserId}, #{invitedUserId}, #{inviteCode}, 'PENDING', now(), 'system', now(), '', now(), '0')
mapper.select: select id, user_id, rule_id, event_type, biz_no, change_points, before_balance, after_balance, description, create_time from wl_point_record where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' order by id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(1) from wl_point_record where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
